name: agent-bom-guard
description: Checks package installs before Claude runs them: blocks known-malicious and typosquatted npm, PyPI, crates.io and Go packages, and warns on known advisories for an exact pinned version. Silent otherwise; never runs the command it inspects.

on_match.title: On a malicious or typosquat match
on_match.description: block stops the install and tells Claude why; warn lets it run and shows the finding.

osv_lookup.title: Look up packages on OSV
osv_lookup.description: Send the package name, ecosystem and version (nothing else) to api.osv.dev. Off keeps every check offline.
